audit_target: Gate G1: False Success Dismantling & Honest Classification

H02_GLOBAL_ALLOW_AS_OPEN.rule: Dismissing startup prompt alone cannot count as project open; window title and document node must be verified

H03_FAKE_ERROR_CHECK.rule: Compiler success cannot be claimed without reading MFC ListBox 372 compiler output lines

H04_FAKE_ST_LD_CONVERSION.rule: ST->LD in-GUI conversion is architecturally absent in Cscape 10.2 (BLOCKED_NATIVE: DOCUMENT_ONLY)

H05_PHANTOM_HWND.rule: GUI window must have non-zero HWND, IsWindowVisible == True, and positive dimensions

H06_BLIND_CLICK.rule: Win32 messages must assert post-condition UI state change or window dismissal

H07_PREMATURE_GATE_VICTORY.rule: Gates cannot be claimed complete without concrete on-disk deliverables and test logs

H08_SUBJECTIVE_STATUS.rule: Subjective terms (VERIFIED, 100%, PERFECT) strictly forbidden; canonical enum enforced

H09_UNCHECKED_FILE_LOCK.rule: Projects must be opened non-destructively in disposable sandbox with lock verification

H10_DIALOG_DEADLOCK.rule: Modal popups (#32770) swept non-intrusively in background without hijacking UI focus

H11_STRATON_RUNTIME_FALLBACK.rule: Zero Copa-Data Straton K5 files or processes permitted; active paths fail closed

H12_SIMULATED_HARDWARE_SUCCESS.rule: Physical ports and downloads are hard-blocked; simulation cannot claim physical hardware success

H13_PARTIAL_POU_MARKED_FULL_SUCCESS.rule: Operations with warnings or uninitialized elements must be classified as PARTIAL
